headline: NFL Week 6 Monday: Commanders at the unbeaten 49ers, 8:15 p.m. ET
whyCareReason: San Francisco are 5-0 and one of three unbeaten teams. Washington are 1-3-1. Kickoff is tonight. No score is posted.

story: Monday, 19 October 2026, is the last game of NFL Week 6. The Washington Commanders (1-3-1) visit the San Francisco 49ers (5-0) at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara. ESPN lists kickoff at 8:15 p.m. ET on ESPN and ABC. The game has not been played, so this card has no score. CBS Sports listed San Francisco as a 7.5-point favorite. The 49ers share an unbeaten record with the Chiefs (5-0) and the Vikings (5-0, on a bye).
stakes: A 49ers win would leave San Francisco as the only unbeaten team still to play this week with a chance to stay 6-0. A Commanders win would be their second of the season.
rivalryAngle: An NFC meeting between a 5-0 home side and a 1-3-1 visitor, with the rest of Week 6 already final.
